history.metric: eligible exact hits / eligible tasks and / all tasks
history.quality: exact prompt, full bytes+modes, external context, launch time, result and costs; no inferred inputs
history.sample: all available local Codex rollouts and OpenCode user messages for this repository at inventory time
history.accept: publish rate only if identity and prior cache eligibility are reconstructible; otherwise negative suitability finding
history.stop: one inventory; no search extension after outcome

accounting.scenario: prospective task execution including transport failure and process restart
accounting.candidate: durable pre-operation and streamed event journal in OpenCode integration
accounting.metric: retained events, solution quality and explicit unknown usage
accounting.quality: strict replay identity; quality independent of execution and telemetry; only fully eligible results learn
accounting.sample: fixed tests: normal, partial response, transport retry, missing usage, nonzero exit, kill before launch, kill during response, kill after response, restart and grade, corrupt journal; exact/mode/context misses
accounting.accept: all stated contracts pass; unobservable provider internals explicitly fail completeness
accounting.stop: no real model calls; fix correctness bugs, retain failing test logs

local.scenario: fresh CLI find on this repository and repeated unchanged find
local.candidate: one improvement selected from separate cProfile/importtime profile
local.quality: identical deterministic JSON excluding runtime observations; existing integrity tests pass
local.sample: five alternating pairs per case: help, find found, find missing; same workspace/config/state scope; profile excluded
local.accept: at least 10% lower median and nonoverlapping ranges on all three cases, zero errors/output differences; otherwise candidate stays off
local.stop: one candidate; five pairs, no extensions

general.metric: full pipeline time and token work including prep, grading, failures
general.quality: all fixed graders pass and usage complete
general.sample: admission checks for local model runtime and historical sealed corpus; no model calls without available runtime
general.accept: no general advantage claim unless a complete identical-input paired study is available
general.stop: if model runtime/binary or auth unavailable, report exact blocked resource; do not substitute synthetic flow

rust.candidate: isolated native hot-path prototype only if profile establishes language-bound work
rust.accept: prototype only if Python execution accounts for >=50% complete local path; no rewrite from microbenchmark
